product.name: VOXIUM
product.integration_goal: One Android application package containing three selectable game engines

java.name: ZalithLauncher2
integration_notes: Application module must be converted or refactored into an embeddable module.
Retain the required unofficial-fork branding and notice conditions.
Do not import upstream signing credentials or secrets.
Keep the Java runtime, LWJGL and native libraries with their required ABI packaging.

bedrock.name: LeviLauncher-Android
integration_notes: The app module must be refactored into an embeddable library or split into reusable core and UI modules.
Resolve manifest, Application, provider, service, activity and resource collisions.
Preserve native CMake components and ARM64 packaging.
Do not bundle proprietary Minecraft APKs or game assets.

starling.name: Starling
integration_notes: Build and package the Rust NativeActivity library and its JNI/Java support classes.
Merge the required activities, services, providers, permissions, metadata and resources into the VOXIUM manifest.
Preserve the player's own legally obtained Java Edition files workflow.
Do not assume Java Edition JVM mods are supported by this native Rust runtime.
